The main takeaway from our work is that
the cellular immune system is able to recognize and eliminate tumours that express viral oncoproteins.
the immune response against virus-induced tumours is not restricted to a single T-cell subset, but involves the concerted action of both CD8+ CTL and CD4+ Th-cells.
